conclusions.assessment: Session 5HyCwPtSDH produced substantial intelligence across 7 parallel investigations. 38 proposals from 7 AARs consolidate into 10 ranked themes. The .gitignore fix (convergence rank 1) is the root cause blocker for 8+ downstream proposals. Three framework proposals (operational learning, context rot mitigation, orchestration patterns) are ready for commander review. The session demonstrated the operational learning cycle: observe (AARs) -> surface (proposals) -> consolidate (this reconciliation) -> propose (amendments). The primary operational learning: codified orchestration patterns would have made this session significantly more effective — the S3 treated missions as independent when they should have been chained.
